package.description: A cross-platform portable binary package manager powered by GitHub releases

en-US.description: A cross-platform portable binary package manager powered by GitHub releases
en-US.longDescription: Wenget simplifies the installation and management of command-line tools and applications distributed through GitHub Releases. It automatically detects your platform, downloads the appropriate binaries, and manages them in an organized directory structure with support for buckets, scripts, and auto-updates.
en-US.name: wenget
